newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet to finish 1997 budget by end - week.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet to finish 1997 budget by end - week.

text.p: The Polish government will finish work on its 1997 budget draft by the end of this week, the government spokeswoman Aleksandra Jakubowska said on Monday.
Jakubowska told a weekly news briefing the details of the adopted budget draft will be revealed at a news conference after a cabinet meeting on Friday.

"Work on the budget will continue at two meetings tomorrow and on Friday. Prime Minister (Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz) wants to sign the budget draft before he leaves for a trip to the Netherlands and Luxembourg," she said.
Cimoszewicz starts his Luxembourg visit on October 28.

The finance ministry draft, submitted to the government on October 10, envisages that the budget deficit will fall next year to 2.6 percent of gross domestic product from 2.8 percent planned for this year.
Under the budget law the government has until the end of October to submit the draft to parliament, which in turn has three months to finish work on the bill.
